## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:factory-guardrails` when guardrail scripts changed

## Classification

- [ ] `auto-merge-ok` — safe to auto-merge after the required checks pass
- [ ] `needs-human` — a person merges this (workflow files, `vercel.json`, env files, deleted tests)
- [ ] `allow-global` — diff touches `.github/**`, a lockfile, or `vercel.json`

`allow-global` does not waive `needs-human`. See `RELEASING.md`.
